verdict.rationale: Replit documents a first-party Replit MCP Server that lets an external client programmatically create, find, inspect, or update Replit Apps. That is a documented machine interface for driving the product, but no conventional public REST API or OpenAPI spec appears (all OpenAPI probe paths returned 404). Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose public API (REST/GraphQL) with reference docs or an OpenAPI spec, endpoint/auth details for the MCP interface, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Connect a compatible client to the Replit MCP Server to create, find, inspect, or update Replit Apps from that client.
